fields.Name: rasa.io API
fields.Description: rasa.io newsletter platform authentication. Requires a username (email), password, and API key — all three together; the exchange fails with any one missing. The connector authenticates via POST to /v1/tokens with HTTP Basic auth (username/password) and the API key in the request body, obtaining a short-lived JWT. That JWT is then presented on every subsequent call as the `rasa-token` request header — NOT as an `Authorization: Bearer` header.
